## ACE operational memory

ACE is operational learning memory for this project. Only the configured QA agents read their own scoped lessons before work and cite any applied `P-NNN` IDs. The QA orchestrator writes traces, updates counters, checks thresholds, and delegates to `gh/ace/reflector` when reached; the generated `gh/ace/reflector`, `gh/ace/curator`, and `gh/ace/warden` own their respective stages. Only `gh/ace/warden` may apply playbook changes after explicit human sign-off. Project instructions and safety rules always take precedence.
